# ICanvas.VisibleArea method

The part of *layer* the player sees this frame, in its units: the camera's view for a layer in the level, the game's area for Overlay.

```csharp
public Rectangle? VisibleArea(Layer layer)
```

## Return Value

Null when the game does not show the layer this frame, such as a layer in the level before the first level is built.
